accepted.sentence: In a family game room, broad levels keep boxed games together beside the table, making selection and cleanup easier.
A sunroom arrangement raises potted plants off the floor, freeing walking space while keeping foliage visible.
In a linen room, folded towels can be stacked by size, making fresh sets easy to locate during room turnover.
A repair workshop can keep service manuals beside workbenches, so technicians can consult instructions without leaving their task.
Separate tiers can hold incoming and outgoing paperwork, reducing mix-ups when household members share a drop-off point.
In a music room, cases for instruments and accessories can be kept together, simplifying setup before rehearsals.
A gallery can arrange ceramics at varied heights, giving visitors clear views of individual pieces without crowding display tables.
In a sports changing area, labeled baskets can keep personal gear separated, helping players find their belongings after practice.
